fusions.name: Jagged Upthrust
fusions.desc: Raises a row of stone spikes through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 13 rock damage to everything in it, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Geode Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a geode packed with mana that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Skin of Granite
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your arcane resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedrock Ward
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
